intro: We do not publish pool prices, because a number on a web page for a custom concrete pool is a guess. Depth, shape, soil conditions, access for equipment, decking, masonry and the spa or water features you want all move the figure substantially — and the yard is different at every address. What we do instead is come out for free, walk the property, take real measurements, and put a written estimate in your hand that explains what is included and what the options cost. Most consultations run one to two hours because we measure everything rather than eyeballing it. Renovation, repair and seasonal service are quoted the same way: look first, then price.
notes: Free on-site consultation and written estimate. Call (570) 855-4235 to schedule.
